confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-02-008, mot phan] Product title chi gom khoang trang (whitespace-only) bi coi nhu KHONG co title: client chan hoan toan, KHONG co request POST /api/products nao duoc gui, san pham khong duoc tao.
confirmed_rules.confirmation_source: PO (2026-09-13, 'case toan whitespace thi coi la khong co title -> khong save duoc') + evidence ACT-02-RC-008-001

confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-02-012, business decision] 'Advanced options' duoc nap tu du lieu import cua nha in ve; khi fulfill can mot so thong tin trong Advanced options moi fulfill duoc nhung dieu nay tuy tung san pham va do nha in quy dinh - TeeInBlue KHONG phu trach phan do.

observed_behavior.statement: Khong field nao co dau hieu bat buoc trong DOM (khong *, khong aria-required) tru khi thu submit thuc te.
Field UI -> payload: 'Internal name' -> label; 'Internal tags' -> internal_tags; 'Fulfillment catalog ID' -> fulfillment_linked_id; Description luu dang HTML.

Server set nhieu field mac dinh khi tao (status=0, had_back=false, enable_custom_printarea=false, color_display_type='radio', size_display_type='radio'); khi khong gui Internal name, server set label = title.
Sau khi tao, redirect + wizard onboarding 3 buoc, trang thai wizard ghi qua PUT /api/user/guide-config.

Nut Advanced options disabled tren /products/new va tren product base tao tay; chi enabled tren product base imported co catalog ID - bien quyet dinh chua xac dinh (fulfillment_id, is_imported, catalog ID, hay dang duoc campaign dung). VAN LA coverage_gap chua duoc lam ro trong run nay.

[CHK-02-009] Tao 10 product base test chi dien Product title, de trong moi field khac: 10/10 deu tra 201 - xac nhan server KHONG bat buoc field nao khac ngoai title o buoc tao Product Base. Voi Printarea: de trong Display name van tao thanh cong (dung default). Voi Variant: de trong Weight/Compare price van tao thanh cong khi du SKU/Color/Size/Price; import thieu SKU tra loi ro rang 'SKU is required in row 2'. PO chi de nghi 'thu run case' (khong assert ket qua cu the) nen giu OBSERVED_CURRENT du evidence manh (10 mau).

[CHK-02-008, phan SEC-002, MEDIUM-HIGH] Title/label chap nhan HTML tho, escape KHONG nhat quan giua 2 vi tri hien thi CUNG 1 field tren list: dong link tieu de escape dung, dong label ben duoi (tu sinh tu title) KHONG escape (chu in dam that, the duoc chen that vao DOM). Payload chua '

risks.risk: Response 422 khi title rong khong co inline field error/highlight, chi co toast - de bi bo sot khi kiem tra UI/accessibility.
Multiselect Fulfillment provider khong co cach bo chon ve 'Others' tu form New - gay kho khan neu chon nham provider truoc khi Save.

Bien quyet dinh enable 'Advanced options' chua ro - rui ro viet test case sai gia dinh ve dieu kien hien thi Required options. Van la coverage_gap chua duoc lam ro trong run nay (KB-070 chi giai thich noi dung/muc dich cua Advanced options, khong giai thich bien UI nao kich hoat no).

[SEC-002, MEDIUM-HIGH, can chuyen security reviewer] Title/label chap nhan HTML tho khong sanitize server-side quan sat duoc; escape khong nhat quan giua 2 vi tri hien thi cung field tren list (dong label khong escape, co the chen HTML/anh that vao DOM). Chua xac dinh day co khai thac duoc thanh XSS thuc su hay khong (onerror khong thuc thi trong sample nay).
